div.div: The person signs in with Google. Velora checks the Google identity token, then either signs in an existing profile, links the Google identity to a matching one, or creates a new profile. A failed new-profile creation is undone so nothing half-made remains.

div.div:
Logical RPC arrows show the caller awaiting a correlated RabbitMQ response; transport envelopes are abstracted.
This view follows valid provider identity and successful saga; Google SDK verification may cache keys, so no unconditional provider HTTP request is invented.
New-user saga failures asynchronously rollback user and await role rollback; not drawn as a successful mutation (google-login.use-case.ts:118-131).
